title: Confirm local waste-sorting and collection rules
summary: Separate waste only in ways supported by current local collection instructions. Check authorised collection routes for batteries and electronic waste.
content:
Waste segregation requirements and accepted materials vary by Urban Local Body and collection provider. Check the current local authority instructions before changing sorting or hand-off practices.

Keep batteries and electronic waste out of mixed household waste when a suitable authorised collection route is available. Verify the current route with the local authority, state pollution control board, or producer take-back programme; this guide does not endorse a particular shop or collection point.
applicability_conditions: Generates waste and needs to decide how to separate or hand it off
implementation_steps: Find the current local authority segregation instructions
Check which dry materials the collection route accepts
Verify a current authorised channel for batteries and e-waste
Keep collection instructions with the workspace's waste log
limitations: Local schedules and accepted materials can change
No specific city collection schedule is asserted
